Name: Soffy's Better Museum Display Cases (With Glasses)
Author: Nekotekina
Description:
With this mod, your artifact collection will be much prettier!

[b]Special note:[/b] 90% of users who download my mods forget to endorse them. If you like this mod, consider endorsing it! It shows appreciation for our efforts and greatly helps me by allowing more people to see it.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/WzQQc1T/ENDORSE.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher;
2. Download this mod & extract [CP] Soffy's Better Museum Display Cases folder to Stardew Valley/Mods;
3. Run the game with SMAPI to play.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]
Compatible with most mods that add additional space in the museum or change its layout, including:

- Bedroom and Kitchenette;
- Extra Museum Space;
- Less Ugly Town Interiors;
- Rocks and Relics;
- Stardew Valley Expanded;
- Visit Mt. Vapius.

If you're using Rocks and Relic's extra space, or Less Ugly Town Interiors, you have to enable this mod's changes through the Generic Mod Config Menu; or you can open the config file in the mod's folder and change the options to "true".

You can also enable/disable the display cases, the glasses, or both.

[b][color=#ffff00]Note:[/color][/b] The interior layout you see in the pictures is from the Less Ugly Town interiors mod.
